items.title: AMD Reports First Quarter 2025 Financial Results
items.snippet: Q1 2025 revenue was $7.4 billion; AMD said the first-quarter results and second-quarter outlook highlighted strength in its product portfolio and execution.

items.title: AMD Reports Second Quarter 2025 Financial Results
items.snippet: Q2 2025 revenue was a record $7.7 billion; AMD said it was seeing robust demand across its computing and AI product portfolio and was well positioned for strong growth in the second half of the year.

items.title: AMD Reports Third Quarter 2025 Financial Results
items.snippet: Q3 2025 data center revenue was $4.3 billion, up 22% year over year, driven by strong demand for EPYC processors and Instinct MI350 Series GPUs.

items.title: AMD Reports Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2025 Financial Results
items.snippet: Full-year 2025 revenue was $34.6 billion; AMD cited record revenue and earnings driven by strong execution and broad-based demand for high-performance and AI platforms.

items.title: AMD Financial Results
items.snippet: Slide deck for Q1 2026 financial results; includes accelerating revenue growth, earnings expansion and record quarterly metrics.

items.title: AMD Unveils Strategy to Lead the $1 Trillion Compute Market and Accelerate Next Phase of Growth
items.snippet: At Financial Analyst Day, AMD outlined a long-term plan to expand data center and AI leadership with greater than 35% revenue CAGR and greater than $20 non-GAAP EPS target.
